text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Turn from 45 mm 6061 bar: 40 mm diameter, 42 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Base 8 mm thick. Centre drill and drill 5.0 mm, 8 mm deep, in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom face; tap M6, 6 mm of full thread, for the magnet's stud.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lower bore 29 mm diameter, from the top of the base up 25 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upper bore 32 mm diameter, from there to the top (9 mm): the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: step between the bores carries the preamplifier board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Face the base inside flat and smooth (0.8 or better): the piezo

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: disc is bonded to it and the signal passes through it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Break all outside edges 0.5 mm. Bead blast if you can.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: magnet stud into the base with threadlocker; disc and mass on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the base; board on the step; potting above the board only.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the base face is flat; the M6 stud runs in by hand.
